title: Alania-2: Turkish text-to-speech with instant and fine-tuned voice cloning
abstract: arXiv:2611.13845v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present Alania-2, a Turkish text-to-speech (TTS) system with two built-in voices, voice design from text descriptions, and two kinds of voice cloning. Alania-2 is a 488M-parameter model with the VoxCPM architecture, which generates continuous audio latents with a diffusion head on top of a language-model backbone. We train it from scratch on 18,195 hours of Turkish speech, 90% of which is synthetic speech produced by a larger teacher model and filtered automatically. A text normalizer rewrites numbers, abbreviations and foreign names into the words a Turkish speaker would say; without it, none of 96 test sentences with digits kept all its critical parts, such as an amount or a date, through synthesis and speech recognition, against 86 with it. On Freya-TR-Eval, a public benchmark of 495 Turkish sentences scored with automatic speech recognition, Alania-2 reaches a word error rate of 1.44%, compared with 5.99% for our previous system.

translated_title: Alania-2：支持即时与微调语音克隆的土耳其语文本转语音系统
translated_abstract: 我们提出了Alania-2，这是一个土耳其语文本转语音（TTS）系统，具有两个内置语音、基于文本描述的语音设计功能，以及两种语音克隆方式。Alania-2是一个4.88亿参数的模型，采用VoxCPM架构，在语言模型主干之上通过扩散头生成连续的音频潜在表示。我们在18,195小时的土耳其语语音上从头训练该模型，其中90%是由更大的教师模型生成并经过自动过滤的合成语音。文本规范化器将数字、缩写和外国名称改写为土耳其语使用者实际会读出的词汇；若没有它，96个含数字的测试句子中没有一个能在合成与语音识别的往返过程中保留所有关键部分（如金额或日期），而有它时为86个。在Freya-TR-Eval（一个包含495个土耳其语句子并通过自动语音识别评分的公开基准）上，Alania-2实现了1.44%的词错误率，而我们之前的系统为5.99%。
tldr: Alania-2是一个基于VoxCPM架构的4.88亿参数土耳其语文本转语音系统，在1.8万余小时土耳其语语音（90%为教师模型合成数据）上从头训练，结合文本规范化技术，将词错误率降至1.44%，并支持即时与微调两种语音克隆方式。
en_tdlr: Alania-2 is a 488M-parameter Turkish TTS system built on the VoxCPM architecture, trained from scratch on 18,195 hours of Turkish speech (90% synthetic from a teacher model), which combines text normalization and dual voice cloning capabilities to achieve a state-of-the-art 1.44% word error rate.
